limitations: available history is left-truncated at the dataset start
eligible counts describe support, not representativeness or validity

cluster_selection.selection_rule: Highest VAL silhouette among candidates with TRAIN mean seed ARI >= 0.75, resample ARI >= 0.60, and minimum 5% cluster share in both eligible TRAIN and VAL customers.

shape_clustering.eligibility_rule: All six historical windows observed, at least two purchase-active windows, and at least one completed pre-cutoff interpurchase gap.
shape_clustering.selection_rule: Highest VAL silhouette among TRAIN-stable candidates with minimum 5% cluster share in TRAIN and VAL; candidate counts require enough eligible rows for stability resampling and validation silhouette.

test_evaluation.component_selection_rule: Choose the fewest components whose VAL reconstruction RMSE is within 5% of the best candidate.

component_stability.interpretation: Higher aligned absolute cosine indicates more similar component directions across TRAIN customer subsamples; it is not a causal or inferential confidence interval.

30.interpretation: Retrospective association only; cluster membership is not causal, and no purchase during the observed horizon is not proof of churn.

60.interpretation: Retrospective association only; cluster membership is not causal, and no purchase during the observed horizon is not proof of churn.

90.interpretation: Retrospective association only; cluster membership is not causal, and no purchase during the observed horizon is not proof of churn.

limitations: association analysis uses future outcomes only after frozen assignments
customers without an assigned trajectory cluster are excluded
bootstrap uncertainty does not correct selection or model-vintage bias
